articles.original_title: Federal government marks continued progress on the Ontario Line

articles.original_title: Federal government marks continued progress on the Ontario Line
articles.original_summary: Today the Government of Canada marked another milestone in the construction of the Ontario Line as the first tunnel boring machine (TBM) broke through to the future King West Station in downtown Toronto.
